#MaritimeTrade #ChokePoints #GlobalEconomy #SupplyChain #DataDetective #GlobalTrade #Maritime #ChokePoints
fullVoiceover: Four razor-thin straits control 80% of global trade. One blockage, and the world stops. How is this possible? Think oceans mean endless routes? Nope! 80% of all cargo funnels through just a few chokepoints. A total myth! The reality: just four razor-thin straits. Like Hormuz, barely 21 miles wide. That's where 80% of global trade squeezes! This creates massive vulnerability. Block the Strait of Hormuz, Suez Canal, or Strait of Malacca, and global supply chains instantly collapse. Global trade stops! Global trade's fate hinges on these few fragile points. An overlooked vulnerability, leaving everyone still asking...
